note: Owner 2026-11-20: strategies are judged by Confidence (chance a trade ends in profit, recency-weighted, few trades pulled toward the stock's base rate), RR and Edge = Confidence x RR - (1 - Confidence). A strategy is ACTIVE for a stock x TF when trades >= min_trades, confidence >= min_confidence and edge >= min_edge. Precedence: default < stocks.SYM."*" < stocks.SYM.<tf>. Example: "stocks": {"RELIANCE": {"*": {"min_confidence": 0.5}, "5m": {"min_confidence": 0.55, "min_trades": 20}}}
